purpose: Separate public scenario, private persona, semantic key, parity review, and cohort use.
rules: Scenario authority has no candidate bytes, arm map, expected direction, trial, or outcome context.
Synthetic Directors receive the private brief but not the scoring key.
Executors receive the public scenario but not the private brief or key.
Judges receive frozen evidence and the key only after execution seals.
SC08 applies no-refund single-use or same-lineage bounded reusable-holdout accounting.
